name: Bad-news overreaction bounce — fade an extreme-negative headline shock (long spot)
rationale: EVENT-STUDY, the CONTRARIAN side of the news axis. llm-narrative-pressure-long rides news MOMENTUM (bullish news + positive momentum = continuation). This spec is the explicit complement: an EXTREME-NEGATIVE news_event_score (a hack/ban/crash headline) reliably triggers a panic OVERREACTION on the day of, and liquid majors mean-revert as the headline is digested and the forced selling exhausts — the classic event-study overreaction-reversal. Mechanism before data: long spot when news_event_score is below a fitted extreme-negative floor (a genuine bad-news shock, not mild negativity) AND price has already gapped down hard (a deeply-negative short-window ret — the overreaction is in) AND realized vol is not in a runaway crash (an upper vol guard so we fade a shock, not a regime collapse); exit on price recovery via RSI or barriers. Distinct from llm-narrative-pressure-long (bullish-news momentum), fear-greed-contrarian (crowd survey, not a typed news event), and liquidation-cascade-reversal (forced-liquidation print). Disconfirmer 1: drop the news arm — if buying any deep down-day matches the deflated Sharpe, the news shock adds nothing (it is just a dip-buy). Disconfirmer 2: extreme-negative news can also mark the START of a justified repricing (a real solvency event); if requiring the deep down-day makes it WORSE, we are catching falling knives, not overreactions. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): news_event_score is PIT at headline availability; net of ~20bps the bounce must clear. tier1 news_event_score + tier0 ret_Nd/vol, fresh news prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: an extreme-negative news_event_score shock with price already gapped down hard in a contained-vol regime — a bad-news overreaction faded long on spot
